customManagers.description: Keep the dtolnay/rust-toolchain@<version> workflow pins in step with rust-toolchain.toml (scripts/check_toolchain_pin.sh fails CI on any drift)

packageRules.description: Hold back the Bevy engine family: every Bevy 0.x minor is breaking, and bevy_rapier2d is a fork pinned to Bevy 0.9 whose default branch lags the pinned commit, so its digest updates are downgrades. bevy_common_assets and ron follow Bevy; rand and getrandom move with it (the wasm entropy pin). They move together in a planned engine migration, not a routine bump
